summary: I reviewed the branch diff against its merge base with main (the only product changes are js/markdown/idea.js, events.js, i18n.js, the #idea-modal markup and CSS in index.html, tests/idea.js, and docs FEATURES.md § J and MAP.md). It meets the original requirement and every decision agreed with the product owner. The search matches chapter titles only, ignoring case and diacritics; workbook names, file names and contents are not searched (each is tested). No match shows a 'No chapter found' / 'Niciun capitol găsit' row, and there is no option to create a chapter. The box opens on the open chapter as a soft default and never remembers the last pick. The × button clears the picker to an empty, focused search. Routing is decided by a single function, ideaResolve(), which both the hint and the save use, so the hint cannot disagree with the save. The order is: (A) a chapter picked by click or Enter always wins and the text goes in verbatim; (B) typed words that point at exactly one chapter win, while none or several matches are ignored and the hint says so; (C) the pre-filled chapter gives way to a 'Name:' prefix that matches a chapter, and that prefix is stripped; (D) otherwise the old 'Name:' routing and the Idei/today fallback apply unchanged. ideaAppendTo() is unchanged, so trailing blank lines are trimmed and exactly one line break is added, and an open-chapter target updates the editor and leaves wbDirty false. All six new strings are i18n keys in both EN and RO, with diacritics intact, and both help paragraphs are updated. Titles are rendered with textContent (a markup title is tested). The keyboard handler mirrors the #idea-text one, and the bug-1 guard added in review (ideaSaving plus try/finally) stops a double save and is released after a failure. I re-ran everything myself: tests/03-for-index-html-page-in-idee/picker.js passes 81/81, double-save.js passes 13/13, tests/verify.js passes (parse, nav sync, diacritics), and tests/idea.js fails only known issue #3 ('💡 button is right of New'). The spec keeps that check out of scope; its adaptation (clicking × before the fallback cases) keeps every existing check. Three non-blocking notes for whoever merges. (1) main has moved on since this branch forked (tasks 01 and 02 merged) and also touches index.html, events.js, i18n.js, FEATURES.md and MAP.md. The hunks I inspected in events.js, i18n.js and MAP.md do not overlap, but git merge-tree was refused here, so re-run node tests/verify.js and the three idea suites on the merge result. (2) The task suite is run with plain node, in the same style as tests/idea.js, and is not in tests/package.json's 'npm test' loop; that loop stops at idea.js anyway because of known issue #3. (3) Filing into the open chapter, now the default target, calls undoReset() and clears the editor's undo history. This is the existing, documented behaviour of ideaAppendTo(), not new to this task, but the user will now meet it more often.
